title: Complete coefficient formula for a power of a binary linear form
statement: For every natural number n, every z∈ℂ, and every exponent index d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, the d coefficient of linePow n z, whose underlying polynomial is (zX₀+X₁)^n, equals (binom(n,d(0)):ℂ)·z^(d(0)) when d(0)+d(1)=n, and equals zero otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.coeff d (HeckeEis.linePow n z).val = if d 0 + d 1 = n then (Nat.choose n (d 0) : ℂ) * z ^ (d 0) else 0
